pluralization.rule: vue-i18n default pluralRules (no custom bg rule in src/boot/i18n.ts)
pluralization.method: Built src/i18n/index.ts with esbuild, created vue-i18n instance (locale bg) and rendered all 9 plural-pipe keys for n in {0,1,2,5,11,21,22,101}. Intl.PluralRules('bg') yields one only for n=1, other for everything else — same partition as the vue-i18n default for 2-form (n=1→form 0, else form 1) and 3-form/zero|one|other (0→zero, 1→one, else other) layouts. Output grammatical for every sampled n (e.g. '1 резултат / 2 резултата', 'преди 1 ден / преди 21 дни', 'преди 1 минута / преди 5 минути').

checks.cyrillicScan: Scripted scan of src/i18n/bg/*.ts: no Russian-only letters (ы, э, ё), no mixed Latin/Cyrillic homoglyph words (only intentional brand/loan terms dreamhubb, Tokens, Feed, Donor/Donee, AI), no doubled-ъ typos besides the one fixed below.
checks.postVsContributionDisambiguation: OK — Post = 'публикация', Contribution = 'принос', CTA contribute = 'ДОПРИНЕСИ'. Top-up = 'ЗАРЕДИ ПУБЛИКАЦИЯТА'. No Post/Contribution confusion.

Tokens — kept as English plural everywhere, incl. singular forms '{n} Token | {n} Tokens' and in compounds ('Юмрук Tokens', 'Шепа Tokens'); consider 'токен/токени' or 'жетон/жетони' — PRODUCT/LINGUISTIC decision.
